issues.issue: The p5 fund statement's General government line (342,090) equals the General department's non-capital spending (341,874) plus C4K's 216. So the report itself counts C4K under general government, not culture/recreation.

The General Fund's Public works figure of 48,470 matches the Cemetery department's non-capital spending on p17 exactly. The statement line therefore holds 48,470 of cemetery spending, but the whole line was mapped to streets/highways. Meanwhile detail[39-45] put Cemetery under health/welfare, as the rules say. As a result the detail's function split doesn't tie to the statement's line.

issues.issue: The label has the extractor's own commentary added to it. The printed label is just 'Loan proceeds'. The actual is printed as '-', the budget as 125,000.

The report doesn't name the grant source. The Statement of Activities (p2-3) shows 203,431 as capital grants (environment and leisure, Park) and 132,218 as operating grants (economic development, CDA). These could be state or other grants, so federal is an assumption. The same applies to detail[14] and detail[86].

The label says reimbursements, and the rules give reimbursements their own category (reimbursements/refunds). Intergovernmental (county payments) is also defensible, so this is a judgment call; the line is already marked review.
